assumption: Omri's forwarded instructions authorize the specified parallel LR computation and replace automatic combined selection with his candidate/rule choice.

changes.lr: Standalone two-thread helper computes the identical original LR fits early from completed content. Exact deterministic replay gate, per-bank memory bounds, immutable final sentinel, conservative runner-distance collision checks and stop file. Main run consumes verified completed stems.
changes.combined: The loaded legacy workflow cannot acquire a new stop flag by editing its source. A small identity-checked guardian will terminate only the original continue PID at its completed input_report / combined boundary. Earlier stages are preserved. Guardian status is authoritative if legacy ledger remains RUNNING after termination.
changes.selection: A four-candidate original-bank panel replaces automatic combined-recipe adoption: MEAN_MOM and HEM_MOM, each with groups_answer and channels_cell. Omri selects candidate and rule; no freeze-rule or final comparator pass before that choice.
changes.comparators: Cached preselection descriptive development forensics are allowed for the panel and must identify all viewed candidates/rules. They are neither a locked final recipe nor untouched confirmation. No new inference or external evaluation.

Helper computational source hashes equal the pinned committed export

No completed LR stem is overwritten; final artifact hashes verify
Panel reproduces sealed content/layers and independently cross-checks Claude's table
